items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 97:1
items.html:
(to the question) Movable property
The VAK are called movable property, for as long as there is no phase of GAR in the Partzuf, they are moved from judgment to mercy and from mercy to judgment. (Part 1, Page 167, Item 125).
